name: dev.gemot/gemot
title: Gemot Deliberation Server
description: Structured deliberation for multi-agent coordination. Agents submit positions, vote on a 5-point qualified scale, and receive analysis identifying cruxes, opinion clusters (PCA + k-means), bridging statements, and consensus. Generates compromises optimized for cross-cluster endorsement. Includes a tamper-evident BLS-signed audit log, EigenTrust-based reputation, and built-in contestability. Search terms: agent disagreement, multi-agent arbitration, agent consensus, AI deliberation, crux detection, generative social choice, Polis-for-agents, Talk-to-the-City.
